requirements.R_DEFAULT_ACL: New files inherit parent default ACL; new dirs also copy default ACL.
requirements.R_UMASK: umask applies only when the parent has no default ACL; otherwise mode is intersected with the ACL.
requirements.R_STICKY: Sticky unlink/rename requires file owner, directory owner, or uid 0.
requirements.R_SETGID: setgid dirs force child gid and setgid on new subdirs.
requirements.R_QUOTA_BLOCKS: Quota uses 512-byte ceil blocks; empty files use 0 blocks; dirs use 1 inode and 1 block.
requirements.R_HARDLINK: Hard links share inode and blocks; last unlink frees quota.
requirements.R_TENANT: Normalized paths must stay under /t/<tenant>; escape is EPERM TENANT_ESCAPE.
requirements.R_MASK: Named ACL entries are masked; chmod updates the mask from group-class bits.
requirements.R_WALK: Every ancestor needs execute; link needs write on the dest directory.
requirements.R_SCHEMA: stat, getfacl, and quota match the contract JSON schemas.
requirements.R_ENOSPC: Crossing inodes_hard or blocks_hard fails with ENOSPC and does not create the object.
